node.statement: Conditioning estimate: for each s, nu_s is mu_s conditioned on C_s, so ||mu_s-nu_s||_1=2*mu_s(C_s^c)=2*beta_s<=epsilon/lambda. Hence ||M-N||_{infinity->infinity}<=epsilon/lambda. Since every probability-row map A is an infinity-norm contraction, ||A(M-N)||_{infinity->infinity}<=epsilon/lambda.
